observations: Grey chest freezer with a top-opening lid.
The interior contains a single wire basket.
A control panel is visible on the underside of the lid.
The brand name 'SCAN' is printed on the front of the unit.

claims.evidence: The interior appears clean in the photo, but the exterior condition is not shown.
The capacity is not visible on the unit in the photo.
The cooling system is not shown; it may be a standard freezer rather than a frost-free model.
The photo shows a standard chest freezer; 'deep' is a subjective term for capacity.

risks.risk: The unit may not be functional or may have a faulty compressor.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit plugged in and running with the lid closed.

risks.risk: The actual capacity may be significantly lower than 93L.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's specification plate, usually found on the back or side.

risks.risk: The interior may be dirty or have significant rust on the exterior.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the interior and the exterior of the unit.
risks.if_unproven: as having a damaged exterior and dirty interior

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the specification plate showing the brand, model, and capacity.
Video of the freezer running to confirm it is cooling.
Photos of the interior and the exterior of the unit.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
